## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers at church, but then offers to introduce her to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). They visit [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly form a deep friendship and pledge to be bosom friends forever. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a delighted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her excitement with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a gift of sweeties.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing the local students and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During afternoon classes, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard, and she refuses to accept Gilbert's apology after school.
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away in town, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) seeks help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when her little sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) falls ill with severe croup. Drawing on her past experience caring for twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night before the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of the [Barry](../character/barry.md) kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts it, falls off, and breaks her ankle. During her long recovery at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who is visited by many supportive friends and neighbors while longing to return to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). At home, she enthusiastically shares her school experiences and upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the concert's value, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks fashionable clothing like other girls, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a dress at Lawson's store but becomes flustered by the clerk, Miss [Harris](../character/harris.md). He seeks help from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who agrees to buy and sew a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift of elegant slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place that evening, where Anne's recitations are a huge success. Afterward, as they walk home, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) mentions [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) saving Anne's dropped rose, while back at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) proudly discuss Anne's performance and her future education.
>

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and discusses growing up, her creative story writing, and a new plan to form a story club with their friends. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the success and rules of the story club, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the endeavor.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) should join. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly accepts the opportunity to study to become a teacher. When the class begins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and realizes she has secretly forgiven him.
>

> After finishing school and taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results at home. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) begin canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) to raise money for the hall. After facing a grim refusal from [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), they receive a secret donation from [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), assist Daniel Blair with baking a cake in exchange for a subscription, and navigate Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to secure another contribution.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) regarding Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the ongoing hall improvement project. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, news spreads across town. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver gather with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay over the disaster.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites her friends on a spring picnic walk to celebrate her unofficial birthday. Along their journey through the woods, the four girls name a hidden forest pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and explore a secluded path. They eventually stumble upon the overgrown, flower-filled garden of the late [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares Hester's touching love story.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's life and garden before spending the rest of the afternoon rambling in the woods. They enjoy lunch by a brook, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) poetically imagine nature and the imagery of souls. Afterward, the girls return home at sunset, having thoroughly enjoyed their outing.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) try to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses. Later, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), Judson hastily agrees to drop the fence advertisements to ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) keeps quiet.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare an elaborate meal in anticipation of guest Mrs. Morgan's arrival. After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the remaining guests eat a quiet dinner that culminates in the destruction of Aunt Josephine's platter. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and will not be coming at all.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P9](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0009), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> Following the broken platter incident, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P68](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0068)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) talk at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to meet her. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about a willow-ware platter at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), and the two girls drive over the next day to get it. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets trapped in the roof of an old duck house while trying to look through the window, but after a rainstorm, Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) returns and releases her.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) why she looked into her pantry window, and the two agree on a price for the blue platter. After enjoying tea with [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) buys the platter for twenty-five dollars, and she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive back along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) laughing over their adventures.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P60](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0060), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where she accidentally dyes her nose scarlet while changing feather beds. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a visit. Despite her initial embarrassment, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful dinner and walk with the guests before they depart.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxiety over [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks about her feelings toward [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) of her steadfast friendship and clarifies that she only views [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as a friend while holding onto her romantic ideal.
>
